justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/compare/ComparableUtils.java, ObjectToStringComparator.java, and package-info.java. The package contains only 2 production classes plus package-info, totaling 325 lines of code across the classes (348 lines including package-info), and both classes are narrowly scoped helpers: ComparableUtils provides comparison predicates/min/max utilities, while ObjectToStringComparator is a single stateless Comparator. This is a small, cohesive package, not an excessively large or responsibility-concentrating God Component.
